name: govuk-delegate-prototype
description: Independent prototype: GOV.UK Delegate, and a mock HMRC service, as separate services. Not an official GOV.UK service.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n onelogin,delegate,hmrc,worker,about,observatory,council -c gray,blue,green,yellow,cyan,magenta,white "npm:dev -w apps/onelogin" "npm:dev -w apps/delegate" "npm:dev -w apps/hmrc" "npm:worker -w apps/hmrc" "npm:dev -w apps/about" "npm:dev -w apps/observatory" "npm:dev -w apps/council"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate --workspaces --if-present && npm run db:seed --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm test -w packages/research-feed && npm test -w apps/observatory && npm test -w apps/council && npm test -w apps/hmrc && vitest run
scripts.council:register: SERVICE_CATALOGUE_FILE=../council/service-catalogue.json DEMO_SERVICE_NAME="Example council" HMRC_SERVICE_KEY=${COUNCIL_SERVICE_KEY:-dev-council-service-key} npm run catalogue:register -w apps/delegate
